ab41077e-e70a-4d09-8c09-b56ecfd59743@ufc.why: No. 4-ranked contender Brendan Allen puts his three-fight winning streak on the line against surging British standout Christian Leroy Duncan, who enters as a No. 10-ranked middleweight on a five-fight winning streak and makes his first UFC main event appearance. A win pushes either man toward a middleweight title shot. In the co-main, Godinez is coming off a submission loss to Tatiana Suarez at UFC 327 in April and looks to bounce back against streaking Ketlen Souza.
ab41077e-e70a-4d09-8c09-b56ecfd59743@ufc.know: Allen is one of the most battle-tested grapplers in the middleweight division, meaning he wins by controlling and submitting opponents, while Duncan relies more on striking. Souza has won two-straight, including a 94-second knockout of Ariane Carnelossi in her previous outing, showing finishing power even without a ranking yet. UFC ranks the top 15 in each division; climbing that list is how fighters earn title shots.

5a58fd06-e8ef-4b11-a524-980603a9b15f@nin.why: San Francisco is 4-0 and 1st in the NFC West, while Seattle sits right behind at 3-1 in second place, and the Seahawks own a current win streak of 2 (2026, present) in this rivalry. This is a division game, so a 49ers win would stretch their lead, while a loss would let Seattle close the gap. It's only Week 5, so nothing is clinched or eliminated here, just an early signal of who controls the division race.
5a58fd06-e8ef-4b11-a524-980603a9b15f@nin.know: A division game matters extra because these results often settle tiebreakers for final standings, and winning the division guarantees a playoff spot. Watch QB Brock Purdy, who has completed 79 of 113 passes for 1,007 yards, 11 touchdowns and one interception this season, as he tries to crack a tough Seattle defense. Edge rusher Nick Bosa (knee, calf) is out for San Francisco, which could open things up for Seattle's offense.

c9169700-4653-416e-ba05-3467ddbfe696@ufc.why: Buckley (#10) meets Malott (#13) in a welterweight main event where the winner pushes toward the division's top five. Buckley is trying to snap a two-fight skid, while home-country favorite Malott is riding a four-fight win streak and seeking his first top-10 win. In the co-main, Blanchfield (#4) battles Jasudavicius (#6) at flyweight, with the winner moving closer to a title shot now that Natalia Silva holds that belt after UFC 332.
c9169700-4653-416e-ba05-3467ddbfe696@ufc.know: UFC rankings run from champion down to #15 in each weight class and shift after big wins or losses, so beating a ranked foe matters a lot for positioning. A fight can end by decision (judges score it) or by finish, meaning knockout (KO), technical knockout (TKO), or submission before time runs out. The main event and co-main are simply the top two, highest-stakes bouts on the card.
